Increment and strength-dependent profile calibrated robustness values

rv_cal.Rd

Computes the weakest added scalar index satisfying 0 < omega <= the calibrated cap that removes significance in the maintained full model.

Usage

rv_cal(model, treatment = NULL,
  calibration = c("increment", "profile", "cap"), benchmarks = NULL,
  vcov = "HC1", cluster = NULL, k = 1, M = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05, critical = NULL, null = 0, ...)

Arguments

model

An unweighted lm model, or an rv_cache. Observed-control calibration requires stored lm metadata.

treatment

Target model-matrix column.

calibration

Restoring-increment, strength-dependent profile, or direct fixed cap.

benchmarks

Separate control units as in rv_benchmarks.

vcov

HC0/HC1, one-way CR0/CR1, HAC_Bartlett_L4, HAC_QS_BW5, TWCR0_raw, TWCR1_raw, or a fixed covariance rule.

cluster

One- or two-way cluster labels aligned with fitted rows, or a formula.

k

Positive profile multiplier. The reference is one; two is a sensitivity scenario.

M

Positive fixed cap when calibration is "cap".

alpha

Two-sided test level.

critical

Optional fixed test cutoff; see rv_sand for defaults.

null

Null coefficient value.

...

Named numerical arguments from rv_sand, including previously found witnesses.

Details

Increment calibration uses M_delta from rv_benchmarks. Profile calibration imposes a0*exp(k*min(L,beta*(sqrt(x)+sqrt(y)))); a0 is the zero-strength augmented-model ratio, with the actual finite-sample correction. Both permit ratios below one. A complete zero profile benchmark gives the constant cap a0 for every k. An empty or invalid pool is never replaced by a zero benchmark.

The profile lower bound uses the crossing of the protected CH bound and the envelope a0*exp(k*min(L,2*beta*sqrt(r))). The unrestricted analytical envelope can strengthen both calibrated lower bounds. Endpoint and fallback candidates are tested against their actual pair-specific cap and independently refitted. Failure to attain the relaxation returns an interval or lower bound only. These are sensitivity assumptions about omitted variables, not consequences of the observed controls.

Value

A robust_rv_result, including the complete benchmark records and profile parameters when applicable. CALIBRATION_UNAVAILABLE has missing bounds. For an already nonrejecting observed test and an available calibration, loss RV is zero by convention. See rv_sand for numerical and inferential interpretation.

See also

sandwich_rv, rv_benchmarks

Examples

fit <- lm(mpg ~ wt + hp + disp, data = mtcars)
rv_cal(fit, "wt", "increment", c("hp", "disp"), run_search = FALSE)
#> RV_cal_delta 
#>   Covariance: HC1 
#>   Baseline decision: reject 
#>   Status: POINT_CERTIFICATE / increment 
#>   Benchmark: zero 
#>   Certificate: verified_interval_within_tolerance 
#>   Certified lower bound: 0.2691982 
#>   Certified upper bound: 0.2691982 
#>   Reported RV: 0.2691982 
#>   Witness omega / robust t: 0.908662 / -2.051831 
#>   Runtime: 0.014 seconds
rv_cal(fit, "wt", "profile", c("hp", "disp"), k = 1, run_search = FALSE)
#> RV_cal_profile 
#>   Covariance: HC1 
#>   Baseline decision: reject 
#>   Status: POINT_CERTIFICATE / profile 
#>   Benchmark: zero 
#>   Certificate: verified_interval_within_tolerance 
#>   Certified lower bound: 0.2691982 
#>   Certified upper bound: 0.2691982 
#>   Reported RV: 0.2691982 
#>   Witness omega / robust t: 0.908662 / -2.051831 
#>   Runtime: 0.009 seconds
